reason: I've already got a Wix page and Fresha takes my bookings, so £655 plus £43 a month is a lot more than the few quid I pay now for something that does the job. Paying only when I'm happy is nice, but it doesn't make the ongoing cost any smaller.
objection: The £43 a month on top of £655 feels steep when Wix costs me far less, and I can't ask anyone in my Facebook group whether he's any good because there are no UK reviews yet.
would_change_my_mind: If someone local in my Facebook group vouched for him and the monthly care plan was optional or around £10-15, I'd let him build it since I'd pay nothing until I'm happy.
